description:
ecologicaltime does not offer technical support. If you have technical questions, please post your question in the comments section of the video. 

My goal is to demonstrate how to solve technical challenges - step by step.

My slogan is:
-- Going around trying to solve problems to make life easier for people --

Although i successfully demonstrate solving a variety of daily challenges, please take care when performing DIY work. 
Use my videos at your own risk.
Videos presented by Philip Baron
